findings.summary: The acknowledgement confirmation icon is hardcoded to Colors.green instead of using a theme/status color, which breaks the design-system color contract and can look off in dark theme.
findings.fix: Replace Icon(Icons.verified, color: Colors.green) with the shared success status color from the status palette (or Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary/secondary), and read it via context so it adapts to light/dark.

findings.summary: The error state is a bare centered Text plus OutlinedButton with no icon or brand affordance, inconsistent with a polished empty/error presentation and lacking any visual hierarchy.
findings.fix: Give the error state an error icon (Icon(Icons.error_outline, color: colorScheme.error)) and consistent spacing/typography matching other pages' error states, keeping the existing retry button.

findings.summary: The title uses a raw const TextStyle(fontSize: 22, fontWeight: w900) instead of the Material 3 text theme, bypassing the design system's typography scale.
findings.fix: Use Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall/titleLarge (copyWith fontWeight if needed) so the title inherits the Cairo font scale and onSurface color consistently.

findings.summary: The body uses a raw const TextStyle(height: 1.8, fontSize: 16) rather than the theme's bodyLarge, hardcoding size and losing onSurface color from the scheme.
findings.fix: Base the style on Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyLarge?.copyWith(height: 1.8) instead of a standalone const TextStyle.

findings.summary: The FilledButton.icon acknowledgement action and the retry OutlinedButton rely on default sizing; the ack button does not enforce the design-system 52px min height explicitly for a primary CTA and there is no tooltip/Semantics on the confirmation icon.
findings.fix: Ensure the primary acknowledge CTA uses the themed FilledButton min height (52) and wrap the standalone verified icon in a Semantics(label: 'مُقَرّ') so screen readers announce the confirmation state.

findings.summary: The published-date is shown as a bare Material Chip while sibling metadata uses MobileStatusPill, mixing two chip styles in the same Wrap row.
findings.fix: Render the date with a styled chip consistent with MobileStatusPill (or a shared date-chip helper) so the metadata row is visually uniform, and apply the design-system chip radius 99.
